title: calophyllum tetrapterum var. obovale
intro: Calophyllum tetrapterum var. obovale, commonly known as the "Yellow Myrtle", is a species of plant in the family Calophyllaceae. It is a tropical tree native to the tropical regions of Asia, valued for its medicinal properties and versatility in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Calophyllum tetrapterum var. obovale include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents which include limonoids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids.
